function_v0.doc: Read-only, authorization-free solvency view for an active or\ndeprecated asset. It never writes state or extends TTLs.
function_v0.name: get_asset_solvency

function_v0.doc: Open escrow currently held by `buyer` for `asset`.
function_v0.name: get_buyer_exposure

function_v0.doc:
Read-only solvency snapshot for a caller-supplied list of one to
`MAX_SOLVENCY_QUERY_ASSETS` assets. Results preserve input order.
Duplicates are evaluated independently and returned once per
occurrence. Assets unknown to this deployment are reported as
`Unknown` with zero values and are never called, so arbitrary
contracts cannot be invoked. `surplus` is `balance - liability`
(negative when underfunded).
function_v0.name: get_solvency

function_v0.doc: Admin-only: sets the ceiling on aggregate open escrow for `asset`.\nLowering it below the current liability is allowed; existing sessions\nare unaffected and new sessions are rejected until capacity returns.
function_v0.name: set_asset_exposure_ceiling

function_v0.doc: Admin-only: sets the ceiling on open escrow any single buyer may hold\nfor `asset`. Each buyer has an independent counter.
function_v0.name: set_buyer_exposure_ceiling

fields.doc: Ceiling on the sum of open escrow for this asset across all sessions.
fields.name: max_asset_exposure

fields.doc: Ceiling on the sum of open escrow for this asset held by any one buyer.
fields.name: max_buyer_exposure

fields.doc: Balance reported by the token for this contract, or `None` when the\nbalance call failed.
fields.name: token_balance

void_v0.doc: Token balance exceeds tracked liability; `surplus` is positive.
void_v0.name: Surplus

void_v0.doc: Token balance is below tracked liability; `deficit` is positive.
void_v0.name: Underfunded

void_v0.doc: The token balance call failed or returned a value that cannot be a\nbalance. Never healthy.
void_v0.name: BalanceUnavailable
